title: explosions of self collapse inward in ever expanding implosions of polygon packing creases of time into tessellations of me, you we, I. #smallpoems #w
summary: explosions of self collapse inward in ever expanding implosions of polygon packing creases of time into tessellations of me, you we, I. #smallpoems #writingcommunity
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
explosions
of self
collapse
   inward
in ever
expanding
  implosions
of polygon
  packing
creases of
  time
into tessellations
  of me, you
we, I.
